fields.description: Set on change; cleared once a full reconcile run has pushed this key to every Active proxy.
fields.label: Pending Sync

fields.description: Full key; encrypted at rest. Shown once on creation, retrievable for reveal-later.
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: Comma-separated model_id list; blank = all published
fields.label: Allowed Models

fields.description: total_tokens this key may consume per calendar month (UTC); blank/0 = unlimited. Enforced by the control plane against the monthly Usage Record total — when reached, rate_limited is set and pushed to the gateways (reactive, resets each month).
fields.label: Max Tokens / Month

fields.description: System-set: this key hit its monthly token budget. Surfaced to gateways as status=rate_limited (→ 429). Cleared by the daily grove.usage_pull.reactivate_rate_limited once current-month usage is back under budget (month rollover / raised budget); stays blocked for the rest of the month otherwise.
fields.label: Rate Limited (budget)
